name: code-modernizer
description: Modernize legacy code chunk-by-chunk with a local LLM, verified in an isolated sandbox before anything is written — from inside VS Code.

commands.title: Code Modernizer: Plan Current File (no LLM/Docker calls)

codeModernizer.repoPath.description: Absolute path to your local code-modernizer checkout (the directory containing main.py). Required.

codeModernizer.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter to run code-modernizer with — point this at code-modernizer's .venv (e.g. /path/to/code-modernizer/.venv/bin/python) so dependencies resolve.

codeModernizer.extraArgs.description: Extra CLI flags appended to every run, e.g. ["--recipe", "py2-to-py3"].
